worker_output.summary: Replaced placeholder races.json stub with full data for all 10 races per design/species/race-stats-complete.md. Each race has: bonuses (production/research/food/growth/groundCombat/shipCombat/espionage/diplomacy), per-field research bonuses/penalties, canConductEspionage/immuneToEspionage flags (Ants: both set correctly), spyRollBonus (Chameleons: 30), specialAbilities, startingTechnologies (4 each), aiBehavior, and shipPrefix. Implemented races.ts with typed RaceDefinition interface and all formula functions from the design doc: applyRacialBonus, applyProductionBonus, applyResearchBonus, applyFieldResearchBonus (handles per-field bonuses/penalties and Rats allFields flag), applyGrowthBonus, applyGroundCombatBonus (with 10% minimum floor), applyShipAttackBonus/Defense (additive shipCombat/10 formula), applyEspionageBonus (Ants two-way isolation, Chameleons flat spy roll + percentage), startingRelationship, applyDiplomacyBonus, hasAbility/getAbility, and Mice-specific helpers (miceEffectiveRCLevel, miceFactoryProduction). No any types, no DOM. All 94 races tests pass; 162 total tests pass. TypeScript compiles clean.
